notes.title: Hawthorn Games' Metagame Collection - Available Now
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the bundle "Hawthorn Games' Metagame Collection" is now available, and you can enjoy a 10% discount when purchasing the bundle.

The bundle includes two Meta Games from Hawthorn Games:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577520/_/

You will act as the Lord of Foe in Game Development Council, who decided to go his separate way due to a conflict. Invade the newly released game Village Guardian. Summon the Predators to destroy villages. Try your best to overthrow the Overlord!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2382580/Paako/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2854330/Paako__Paako/

A Game Called Paako is a pixel-art 2D platformer metagame that tells the story of a game major graduate student making his thesis game project: A Game Called Paako. 
The base game is free, and purchasing the DLC unlocks some interesting content.

notes.title: Paako v1.2 Polished version update (Achivement display updated)
notes.content:
What's new in this update:

 Polished content the final part.
 Achievement display panel after beating the game.
 A more straightforward guide for the epilogue sequence.
 Fixed minor bugs of the final puzzle.

Feel free to join our Discord.

Thank you for playing this game. Hope you enjoyed it.
C.Huang

notes.title: A Game Called Paako Available Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113710/b5ddbf23f40ebaac5b150c8f42a55c8519ab8a27.png
Hello everyone!

This is Chaoba. Thank you all for your patience, and I'm pleased to announce that A Game Called Paako is  officially launched today. (Finally!)

Regrettably, the quality of the dialogue script in the latter half of the game has not yet reached the perfect state I envisioned, and there may still be some minor flaws in the levels. We will be continuously updating and thoroughly improving this game within the week. (Because we really can't delay any further.)

Considering that this is, after all, a game best experienced for the first time, if you wish to have the ideal experience, you may also consider waiting for the patch to be released before playing. (After waiting for so long, what's one more week?)

If you don't mind a few minor flaws, you are also welcome to join our Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113710/0486e62d5856ee1c9e09a48271558935be552f49.png

Additionally, it's interesting to note that yesterday was the award ceremony for the IGF this year. And exactly one year ago tomorrow was the day I came up with the first promotional script for Paako. I guess that's fate. (I can't say exactly what kind of fate it is, but it's quite a coincidence.)

Thank you for your attention and gameplay!

- Chaoba
